description: Draws a geologic cross section between two Texas points (or through one point along a bearing): ground surface and every aquifer and confining unit of the Texas Water Development Board groundwater availability models, with top and bottom elevations, fresh versus brackish zones and outcrop, sampled along the line on a 1-mile model grid. Adds the state water wells within a buffer of the line, projected onto the section with their screens, depths, reported yields, salinity and the formation they produce from. Use for 'show me a cross section from here to there', 'how deep is the Simsboro across this county', 'where does the aquifer turn brackish', 'what formations would a well cross here'. Model layers are regional (about one mile), not a site survey: confirm with a test hole and geophysical log. Enterprise.

address.description: Center address, with bearing_deg and length_mi, instead of from/to.

bearing_deg.description: Direction of the line through the center point, degrees from north. Default 135 (northwest to southeast, roughly down dip on the Gulf Coast plain).

lat.description: Center point, with bearing_deg and length_mi, instead of from/to.

length_mi.description: Line length when a center point is given. Default 20, max 80.

well_buffer_mi.description: Show wells within this distance of the line. Default 1, max 3.

name: water_cross_section
title: Geologic cross section along a line
